sentences.text:
Petitioner :- M/S Radhika Namkeen Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Ajeet Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Respondent :- CSC Hon'ble Surya Prakash Kesarwani,J.
Hon'ble Jayant Banerji,J.
Against the impugned order dated 09.06.2022 in Case No.1084 of 2019 under Section 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, the petitioner has a right of appeal before the Tribunal.
Sri Pradeep Kumar Singh, learned standing counsel states on instructions that now Tribunal is functional and, therefore, the petitioner may file an appeal before the appropriate Tribunal.

In view of the aforesaid and without expressing any opinion on merits of the case of the petitioner,
the writ petition is dismissed leaving it open for the petitioner to file an appeal before the appropriate Tribunal.
